gen-gf-cabin-sketch-gf-piazzolla: Cabin Sketch draws stout, rounded-wire letters with a flattened, pen-nib bowl look. Piazzolla follows in a text serif whose lowercase nearly matches its capitals, so the heavy heading and the refined body sit comfortably together.
gen-gf-cabin-sketch-gf-pridi: Pridi reads classic and refined, with small letters standing almost capital-sized. Cabin Sketch adds a bold, wiry outline, one line of constant weight tracing each letter, and that gives the pair its character against such a courtly body.
gen-gf-cabin-sketch-gf-scope-one: Scope One is traditional, with a big x-height and stubby ascenders. If Cabin Sketch is made small, its stout, pipe-cleaner strokes crowd together and lose their charm, so it needs room to be seen.
gen-gf-caesar-dressing-gf-graduate: Tall, quirky lowercase leaps out of Caesar Dressing, standing high against its capitals, while Graduate lines up beside it with generous gaps between letters. Graduate reads dignified, bookish and steady throughout.
gen-gf-calligraffitti-gf-cascadia-code: Calligraffitti has a towering midzone, with strokes that look traced by a marker. Cascadia Code sits beside it as a plain sans with wire-like monoline lines and wide gaps between neighbors, giving the loose handwriting something tidy to lean on.
gen-gf-calligraffitti-gf-graduate: Friendly and graceful, Calligraffitti writes in marker-traced strokes with a towering midzone. And Graduate, a dignified serif with little difference between capitals and lowercase, grows bigger than the heading if you want the body to feel solid.
gen-gf-calligraffitti-gf-julius-sans-one: Calligraffitti stands tall in the middle, with marker-traced strokes. If it is made small, that towering midzone loses its swagger, while Julius Sans One keeps its blank, open-ended curves and light feel at nearly any size.
gen-gf-calligraffitti-gf-lexend-exa: Friendly marker strokes with a towering midzone give Calligraffitti its warmth, and below it Lexend Exa brings a clean, professional body with wide curves and stubby ascenders. The strongest quality is how loose handwriting meets tidy order.
gen-gf-calligraffitti-gf-lexend-giga: Lexend Giga reads modern and professional, with flat single-weight linework and generous tracking that opens each word into its own space. Calligraffitti on top is the pair's strongest quality, a loose marker hand against tidy order.
gen-gf-calligraffitti-gf-lexend-mega: Approachable and modern, Lexend Mega draws with what looks like one nib, with a body height that nearly matches its capitals and a visible gap in every c. Calligraffitti's marker strokes loosen it up nicely.
